execution_authorization: Routine feasibility work delegated; attempts require documented technical qualification and packet lock.
workflow_rule: Sort workflow IDs; SHA256 UTF-8 of OSRI-health-data-pilot-v1|CASE-ID; interpret first 16 hex digits as integer; modulo workflow count gives zero-based index.
packet_boundary: Execution-facing fields only: no reference-selected records, expected values, fixture, checker output or feedback.
assessment: Independent reference and assessment packet not yet prepared; kept outside this execution-facing record.
limits: Fixed per-case controls: 3 active executor hours, 6 elapsed hours, 4 VM-hours, 4 vCPU, 16 GiB RAM, 100 GiB disk, 20 GiB network. Include reference capture in case meters. One transient retry OR one diagnostic repeat; preserve the initial outcome.
executor: Not appointed; environment and supervisor must be frozen before any authorized execution.
output_lock: Location and custodian not assigned; primary log and output must be locked before unsealing assessment.
review: Coordinator verifies eligibility, inventory, version, environment and access; major claims and independent-human-review assertions remain subject to human review.
identity_and_eligibility: Public implementation downloads external CMS hospital cost-report files; non-patient facility/report data; eligibility provisional. Distinct from CMS publisher and other HCRIS tools.

revision.choice: Default master HEAD; read-only git ls-remote returned no tags and GitHub releases page reported no published releases. API releases request was rate-limited 403; release check remains subject to coordinator verification before lock.

workflows.description: Acquires CMS fiscal-year hospital cost report ZIPs and extracts report, numeric, alphanumeric files; years and form versions are parameters of one downloader path.

workflow_enumeration_limits: README and named downloader inspected; project also offers manually downloadable processed results and transformation scripts, not separate implemented external acquisition workflows. Full tree and hidden undocumented paths not exhaustively audited.

selected_task.scope: Full documented script default 1996–2024, source 2552-96 for years <=2011 and 2552-10 for years >=2010. Both versions requested in 2010 and 2011.
selected_task.output: Extracted and renamed CSV files in ./source; script removes downloaded ZIPs.

source.release: Script requests year-specific URLs; actual publisher revision and retrieval window require prospective lock before attempt.

runtime: Bash, wget, unzip, network and filesystem storage; script does not state account requirement. Output size, endpoint availability, terms and safety/resource fit unknown. Full downstream processing additionally requires R and related dependencies.
risks: No repository code run. Default full range may exceed resource limits; do not shorten after outcome. Script removes archives and uses HTTP; first assess safe acquisition and retention. No completed source-access, license, storage or independent-reference check.
configuration: Coordinator applies immutable source pinning as environment configuration; no source patches or silent version changes.
